newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-LITTLE OUT OF WALLABY TEAM TO PLAY NZ.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LITTLE OUT OF WALLABY TEAM TO PLAY NZ.

text.p: Australian centre Jason Little has been replaced by Daniel Herbert in the Wallabies team for Saturday's Bledisloe Cup rugby test against the All Blacks at Christchurch's Lancaster Park.
Little tore a hip muscle in last Saturday's second test win over France in Brisbane and had been in doubt all week.
He had been given until Friday to prove his fitness but was unable to run freely enough to satisfy the Wallabies' medical staff, who had never rated him better than a 50-50 chance of playing.
Little did not train with the team during week, with Herbert taking his place in all sessions.
